common.newsletterNoSpam: No spam. Unsubscribe at any time.
common.newsletterThanks: Thanks — we'll be in touch at {{email}}.

login.title: Sign in to {{app}}
login.description: Enter your email and password to continue.

signup.title: Create your {{app}} account
signup.description: You'll get a confirmation email to finish signing up.
signup.sentAfter: for a confirmation link. You can close this page.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: We'll email you a link to choose a new one.
forgotPassword.sentAfter: , a reset link is on its way. The link expires in one hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.descriptionReady: Enter a new password for your account.
resetPassword.descriptionNoSession: Open this page from the link in your email.
resetPassword.needsRecoverySession: This page needs the recovery session created by the emailed link. Request a new link if yours has expired.

callback.title: Signing you in…
callback.description: One moment while we finish setting up your session.

setup.title: Supabase isn't configured yet
setup.description: Auth needs a project URL and anon key before it can run.
setup.anonKeyNote: The anon key is public by design — row level security protects the data, not the secrecy of that key.

400.title: That request did not make sense
400.description: The server could not read the request. This usually means a link was edited by hand or a form was submitted twice.

401.title: You need to sign in
401.description: This page is only available to signed-in accounts. Your session may simply have expired while the tab was open.

403.title: Not permitted
403.description: Your account doesn't hold the permission this page requires. If you think that is wrong, ask an administrator to check your roles.
403.hint: If a role was just granted, sign out and back in — permissions travel in the access token.

404.title: Page not found
404.description: The page you asked for does not exist. It may have been renamed or removed, or the link that brought you here may be out of date.

408.title: The request timed out
408.description: The server took too long to answer. A slow or intermittent connection is the usual cause.

410.title: This page is gone
410.description: The resource used to live here and has been permanently removed. There is no new address to forward you to.

429.title: Too many requests
429.description: You have hit a rate limit. Wait a moment before trying again — repeated retries will keep the limit in place for longer.

500.title: Something went wrong on our side
500.description: An unexpected error stopped this page from loading. Nothing you did caused it, and it has been logged.

502.title: Bad gateway
502.description: A service this page depends on returned an invalid response. It is usually a deployment in progress and clears on its own.

503.title: Temporarily unavailable
503.description: The service is down for a short while. It should be back without you having to do anything.

504.title: Gateway timed out
504.description: An upstream service did not answer in time. This tends to resolve within a minute or two.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.description: This device has no network connection, so the page could not be loaded. The page will tell you as soon as the connection is back.

maintenance.title: Down for maintenance
maintenance.description: We are making a planned change and will be back shortly. Nothing is lost — your data is untouched.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.description: We could not work out what failed. Reloading fixes most of these; if it does not, the link may be broken.
